figurative_meaning_en: defamation or gossip that harms reputation
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্ধুদের সম্পর্কে কানকথা শুনতে আমি চাই না।
example_sentences_in_english: I don't want to hear gossip about my friends.
She always spreads rumors about others.
note: Refers to whispered or indirect talk that often leads to reputational harm in social circles
